mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k, or Rank IC drops below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and retail sales finance spending indicate weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of interaction-triggered instances, or the joint signal's Rank IC is below 0.025 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 98.0 (index 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profitability and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rebound in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) following a prior contraction signals a recovery in consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1.5% MoM after two consecutive MoM declines
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.0% annually, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank hawkishness, leading to higher real rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of interaction-triggered instances, or the joint signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% and a rise in non-farm payroll growth above 250k signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 0.5% annualized, combined with declining housing starts, signals a weakening economic expansion that reduces corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of interaction-triggered instances, or the joint signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
